concepts.title: Aurora Fold
concepts.prompt_direction: A folded indigo and cyan portal, moving from a utility badge toward a premium entry mark.
concepts.strength: Crisp, contemporary and highly recognizable in a small square.
concepts.tradeoff: The new cyan treatment would need a small supporting color update in the current blue-only workbench.

concepts.title: Ink Signal
concepts.prompt_direction: A single energetic ink-like gesture resolves at a precise copper proof point.
concepts.strength: Warmer and more distinctive; gives Harness a human intent-to-execution story.
concepts.tradeoff: Most expressive option, so the final SVG must simplify the brush texture for small sizes.

concepts.title: Open Portal
concepts.prompt_direction: Two translucent offset bands create an open doorway in plum and coral.
concepts.strength: The freshest visual identity and strongest visual separation from typical AI products.
concepts.tradeoff: The largest departure from the current website palette and requires a more intentional supporting theme.
